items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser keeps skin clean without stripping it or adding to dullness.
Hyaluronic acid adds a light layer of hydration, which suits a moisture score of 59 and can make skin look fresher.
A light ceramide moisturizer supports the skin barrier without feeling heavy on oily-looking skin.
A mineral SPF 50 each morning helps protect skin from daily sun exposure and uneven-looking tone.

response.routine_note: I've left out the 30% peel (LL-110) and the other exfoliating acids because strong peels aren't a good fit during pregnancy, so please check any active products with your prenatal provider first. Use the cleanser, serum and moisturizer morning and night, and finish with the SPF each morning.
